entries.title: Atria Dawn
entries.summary: Shanghai AI Laboratory's Atria Dawn joins the catalog: an open-weight agentic model on a 744B GLM-5.2 base with a 512K-token context, through BYOK.

entries.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro
entries.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro joins the catalog: a 2.8T-parameter open-weight model with a 1M-token context and native vision, through BYOK.

entries.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed
entries.summary: The high-speed variant of Kimi K3.1 Pro: the same model at about 2-3x the output speed, through BYOK.
